We're hiring a Senior Sales Executive at our Tidel Park office to work on exciting projects in Automotive.

**Key Responsibilities:**
• Design, build, and maintain high-quality solutions
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams
• Write clean, tested, production-ready code
• Participate in code reviews & architectural decisions

**Requirements:**
• Strong proficiency in Sales, CRM, Communication
• Experience with Negotiation
• Excellent problem-solving skills

**What We Offer:**
• Competitive salary, PF, health insurance, flexible WFH, learning budget
• Located at: Tidel Park, Tamil Nadu
• A collaborative, inclusive work environment
